briefs.case-fda-H-0022-2027:
# ACT NOW — recalled stock is on our shelves

**fda:H-0022-2027** · Saint Francis Apizza LLC · 2026-10-01

> Saint Francis Apizza Frozen Cheese Pizza, Net Weight: 17 oz. (482g), packaged individually in vacuum-sealed plastic…

## Why
The FDA recall notice from Saint Francis Apizza LLC identifies Frozen Cheese Pizza with UPC 666186277591 as containing undeclared soy allergen from soybean oil and soy lecithin, with all Best By dates through 3/30/2027 affected [E1][E2][E3][E6][E7]. Our product match confirms SKU NW-100117 shares this exact UPC, and the all-lots rule verifies that our 12 listed lot codes fall within the notice scope [E8][E9][E10]. We currently hold 379 units of these recalled lots across 6 stores, and 100 units have been sold to 60 loyalty customers since the recall date of 2026-10-01 [E11][E12][E13][E14].

## What we matched
- `NW-100117` FROZEN CHEESE PIZZA 17OZ — **same** (rule, upc): our UPC 666186277591 is printed in the notice

## Actions
- Pull lots L24-6872, L24-7620, L24-8205, L24-8948, L24-9744, L25-1409, L25-2454, L25-2768… from 6 store(s): S023 (104), S021 (101), S009 (82), S013 (55), S003 (20), S002 (17) [E12]
- Send recall notice to loyalty customers who bought affected lots since 2026-10-01: at most 60 [E14]
- Contact Supplier S025 (synthetic) for credit and replacement [E15]

## Caveats
- Retailer data is synthetic (Northwind Mercantile, generated for this demo).
- The notice lists no lot codes we could verify, so every lot of the SKU is treated as affected.
- Stores in GA, FL, IL, WI, OR, CA hold stock although the notice's distribution list does not name those states — product can travel through distributors, so this is not a clearance.
- Customer count sums weekly distinct counts, so it is an upper bound.

> Todd's Seeds Salad Sprouting Mixture - Broccoli, Mustard, Alfalfa and Cabbage, packaged in heat-sealed resealable bags…

## Why
The FDA recall notice from Todd's Seeds LLC identifies Salad Sprouting Mixture Lot No. TS-633-2 as potentially contaminated with E. coli and/or Salmonella due to a downstream supplier recall [E1][E2][E3][E6]. A reviewer decided that our SKU NW-100005 corresponds to this recalled product despite the 4LB size not matching the notice's listed sizes, so it must be treated as recalled until receiving confirms the bag size [E7]. Our inventory holds 44 units of the affected lot across 2 stores, specifically S009 IL with 32 units and S018 NJ with 12 units [E8][E10][E11][E15].
